# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Check for a DSHS ED Data Exchange Report in their records that was filed after October 1, 2010.
3. Omission / Report Triggered
4. In reports where an omission trigger is used, the bill'n information is listed as "Unavailable." If a report is triggered, call the facility to verify the information listed for the worker/victim.
5. In all cases information is updated from the report to further trigger when additional information is included in new reports.
6. When appropriate, review reports from surrounding years to gather additional information on an incident.
